description_en: Creates a gateway quota throttling rule
description_zh: 新增网关配额限流规则
kebab_example: aliyun apig add-gateway-quota-rule --gateway-id gw-d8ki1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --period-type week --quota-dimension token --quota-limit 1000 --rule-name team-rule --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddGatewayQuotaRule

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The conflict snapshot hash, which is used to prevent concurrent dirty overwrites when you confirm to overwrite. You can obtain this value by first executing a dry run with dryRun=true and extracting it from the returned data.

You do not need to specify this parameter in the following scenarios: no conflicts exist; you are only performing a dry run with dryRun=true; or overwrite=false, meaning you do not confirm overwriting.

If dryRun=false and overwrite=true but this parameter is not provided or has expired and does not match, the backend returns accepted=false along with a new conflict preview. In this case, you must perform a dry run again to confirm the new conflicts
parameters.help_zh:
冲突快照哈希，用于“确认覆盖时防并发脏覆盖”。通过先执行dryRun=true在返回数据提取。

当以下情况不需要填写：没有冲突；只是dryRun=true预检；overwrite=false，即不确认覆盖。

当当dryRun = false且overwrite=true时不带改参数或者该参数过期不匹配，后端会返回：accepted=false并带新的冲突预览，需要重新执行dryrun确认新的冲突
parameters.name: conflict_hash

parameters.help_en: The list of consumer group IDs to which the rule is bound. This parameter is used when subjectType is set to consumer_group and cannot be specified together with consumerIds
parameters.help_zh: 绑定规则的消费者组ID列表
parameters.name: consumer_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of consumer IDs to which the rule is bound. You can specify up to 1,000 consumers in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 绑定规则的消费者ID列表。单次最多可操作 1000 个消费者
parameters.name: consumer_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without saving the configuration to the database or delivering the actual configuration. This is used to check whether conflicting rules exist on the bound consumption subjects. A single consumption subject cannot be configured with two natural period quotas of the same period. For example, a consumption subject that already has a natural day quota cannot be added with another natural day quota rule
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅预检（预检不下发实际配置），用于检查绑定的消费主体上是否存在冲突的规则（同一消费主体不能配置两个相同周期的自然周期配额，例如已有自然日配额的消费主体不能再新增一个自然日配额规则）
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when a conflict occurs. If overwriting is allowed, the conflicting subjects (consumers or consumer groups) are unbound from the old rule and bound to the new rule
parameters.help_zh: 冲突时是否允许覆盖。注意如果选择允许覆盖，冲突主体（消费者或消费者组）会从旧规则解绑并绑定到新规则
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en: The period multiplier. This parameter applies to custom period rules and specifies that the rule is reset every X periods
parameters.help_zh: 周期倍数。该参数针对自定义周期规则
parameters.name: period_multiplier

parameters.help_en: The period type. For a natural period, statistics can be collected by day, week, or month. Valid values: day, week, and month. For a custom period, statistics can only be collected by day. Fixed value: day
parameters.help_zh: 周期类型。自然周期支持按日、周、月统计，取值为 day、week 或 month；自定义周期仅支持按日统计，固定取值为 day
parameters.name: period_type

parameters.help_en:
The quota dimension or limit type. Valid values:
credit: Quota throttling measured by credits consumed.
token: Quota throttling measured by token count
parameters.help_zh: 配额维度/限制类型，目前支持token、credit
parameters.name: quota_dimension

parameters.help_en: The total available quota (limit) per period
parameters.name: quota_limit

parameters.help_en: The subject type of the rule. A value of consumer indicates a consumer. A value of consumer_group indicates a consumer group. Default value: consumer
parameters.help_zh: 规则主体类型。consumer代表消费者；consumer_group代表消费者组。不传时默认为consumer
parameters.name: subject_type

parameters.help_en: The time zone corresponding to the natural period, in the UTC+x format
parameters.help_zh: 自然周期对应的时区(UTC+x格式)
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.help_en: The reset period type. A value of calendar indicates a natural period, which takes effect from the start of a natural day, week, or month. A value of epoch indicates a custom period, which takes effect when the rule is delivered
parameters.help_zh: 重置周期类型。支持自然周期（windowAlignment=calendar）和自定义周期（windowAlignment=epoch）
parameters.name: window_alignment

code.description_en: The status code or error code

accepted.description_en: Indicates whether the semantics of the current write request can be accepted by the system. A value of false typically occurs in retryable scenarios, such as when a conflict is not confirmed for overwriting
accepted.description_zh: 本次写请求语义是否可被系统接收，false 常见于冲突未确认覆盖等可重试场景
accepted.title_en: 是否接受请求。dryRun=true时仅表示预检已受理，不表示已保存；正式写入返回false时表示因冲突未保存，应检查conflictPreview。
accepted.title_zh: 是否接受请求。dryRun=true时仅表示预检已受理，不表示已保存；正式写入返回false时表示因冲突未保存，应检查conflictPreview。

items.description_en: The list of conflicting subjects (consumers or consumer groups)
items.description_zh: 冲突的主体（消费者或消费者组）列表

items.description_en: The details of the conflicting subject (consumer or consumer group)
items.description_zh: 冲突的主体（消费者或消费者组）详情

conflictPeriodType.description_en: The period type of the existing conflicting rule on the consumption subject. A value of day, week, or month indicates that the period of the existing conflicting rule is day, week, or month, respectively
conflictPeriodType.description_zh: 消费主体上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示消费主体已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月
conflictPeriodType.title_en: 历史声明字段，请使用实际响应中的periodType；本字段不保证返回。
conflictPeriodType.title_zh: 历史声明字段，请使用实际响应中的periodType；本字段不保证返回。

conflictType.description_en: The type of the existing conflicting rule on the consumption subject. A value of calendar indicates that the existing conflicting rule is a natural period rule. A value of epoch indicates that the existing conflicting rule is a custom period rule
conflictType.description_zh: 消费主体上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费主体已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期
conflictType.title_en: 消费者上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费者已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期。
conflictType.title_zh: 消费者上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费者已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期。

consumerId.description_en: The ID of the conflicting consumer. This parameter is deprecated. Use subjectId instead
consumerId.description_zh: 冲突消费者 ID（现可统一使用 subjectId 替代）

consumerName.description_en: The name of the conflicting consumer. This parameter is deprecated. Use subjectName instead
consumerName.description_zh: 冲突消费者 ID（现可统一使用 subjectName 替代）

periodType.description_zh: 已有冲突规则的周期类型，day、week、month分别表示日、周、月
periodType.title_en: 已有冲突规则的周期类型，day、week、month分别表示日、周、月。
periodType.title_zh: 已有冲突规则的周期类型，day、week、month分别表示日、周、月。

subjectId.description_en: The ID of the conflicting subject

subjectName.description_en: The name of the conflicting subject

subjectType.description_en: The type of the conflicting subject. Valid values: consumer and consumer_group
subjectType.description_zh: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group
subjectType.title_en: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group。
subjectType.title_zh: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group。
